Author: Vamprincess Dorene
Name: Cursed Identify
Description:
Companion plugin for the 'Cursed Identify (/study)' Penumbra emote mod.

During the /study skit, at the moment of the magical-girl transformation, it asks Glamourer to equip the cursed neon-pink leotard (Yakaku Dogi, which the mod replaces with the Succubi Leotard) and to strip head/hands/legs/feet. When the skit resets, or you stop the emote, your previous outfit is restored exactly.

Requires: Glamourer, and the Cursed Identify (/study) mod enabled in Penumbra.
Commands: /cursed opens the window (enable toggle + test buttons); /cursed on | off apply or restore by hand; /cursed toggle enables/disables the swap.

Visor Flash (v1.1.0): typing /visor switches the 'Charm Shirt Halter (Rue + YAB)' mod's Style option between Normal and Flash in the collection your character uses and redraws you, so it changes live. The game's own visor toggle still happens too. Needs Penumbra and the Charm Shirt Halter mod. Commands: /visor; /visorflash on | off | normal | flash (no argument opens the window).
Punchline: The cursed smallclothes really do lock onto you, and /visor flashes the Charm Shirt Halter. Companion to the Cursed Identify (/study) and Charm Shirt Halter mods.
